meta.name: WealthSmith Semantic Radius Tokens
meta.description: Semantic border-radius tokens map primitive radius values to product UI meaning. Components should use these tokens instead of raw radius values.

sm.description: Small surface radius for compact cards and contained UI blocks

md.description: Default surface radius for cards, modules, and dashboard panels

lg.description: Large surface radius for prominent panels and feature cards

xl.description: Extra-large surface radius for modals, sheets, and high-emphasis containers

sm.description: Small control radius for compact inputs, selects, and secondary controls

md.description: Default control radius for buttons, inputs, selects, and action controls

lg.description: Large control radius for prominent CTAs and large interactive controls

pill.description: Fully rounded control radius for pill buttons, filter chips, and segmented controls

default.description: Default radius for badges, tags, status pills, and small labels
Default radius for avatars and circular identity elements
Default bottom sheet, side sheet, and overlay panel radius

bar.description: Default radius for chart bars and small visual data elements

inner.description: Default radius match for focused controls
